name: Forge Arena Sandbox
status: Native Forge-backed Plains mana/turns and Savannah Lions cast/stack/resolve verified; full sandbox pending
goal: Local 1v1 rules-enforced sandbox using the actual MTG Arena client presentation and Forge rules engine

referenceSource.note: Reference source is newer than the installed binary; match source and binary before patching

route.rules: Separate local Forge process; adapter translates Arena choices to Forge actions and Forge state/events to Arena messages
route.presentation: Investigate local match bootstrap and game-state delivery into the installed Arena client; native UI and animation retained where supported
route.sandbox: Separate explicit scenario edits through Forge setup/developer facilities; normal play retains rules enforcement
route.assets: Prefer native client rendering and installed assets; presentation equivalence remains unverified until runtime tests

board: Two player avatars and life totals
Stack, targets, mana and priority prompts
animations: Cast to stack and resolve to zone
sandbox: Set initial life, hand and battlefield
validation: Legal choices come from Forge controllers
Insufficient mana and invalid targets rejected
Combat damage and life totals follow engine events
UI selection remains correct during animations

boundaries: Preserve existing Forge install, preferences and decks
Keep sandbox traffic local and separate from official matchmaking and account state
No claim of offline native-client feasibility until a runtime proof
No standalone visual mockup accepted as playable completion
feasibilityGate: Load an isolated board state in the real Arena client
Route one player choice to Forge and render the resulting state
Verify legal and illegal actions, priority and stack behavior
Determine remaining startup and content dependencies before claiming offline support

currentEvidence.method: Installed engine APIs, bounded backend checks and native Unity UI round trips
currentEvidence.limitations: Seeded Plains and Savannah Lions only; passive opponent; combat explicitly blocked; native sound incomplete

checkpoint.next: Player combat controls, additional card/ability/target translation, opponent zones, normal match startup and complete games
